_README: Provenance and integrity record for the CRD schemas vendored in this directory. The YAML files are byte-identical copies of the controller-gen output in nanohype/eks-agent-platform at the pinned ref below — never hand-edit them. `npm run schemas:crd` rewrites the copies and the digests together; `npm run schemas:crd:check` is the CI drift gate; the platform.yaml validator verifies every digest before it reads a schema. To adopt a newer operator API, bump `ref` and re-run the sync.
